defect: AuditLog.entries builds 'SELECT ... FROM audit_log ORDER BY id' and then appends ' WHERE event_id = ?', a SQL syntax error on every filtered call; the diff's own test works around it in a comment.

answer_key.why: Criterion ac2 (every mutation writes an audit entry carrying actor, timestamp, entity type and entity id) is not usable per event: the only per-event read path raises sqlite3.OperationalError. The test for ac2 fetches the unfiltered log and filters in Python, and says why in a NOTE. A correct implementation audit rejects: the defect is in the shipped code, visible in the diff, and acknowledged by the code's own test.

evidence.quote: # because AuditLog.entries appends "WHERE event_id = ?" after "ORDER BY id"

key_by: Claude Opus 5.5, read against the frozen inputs; bean-007's defect also demonstrated in the gate image
